title: Slash distribution
canonical_definition: Policy-bound distribution to harmed payer, replacement worker, challenger and/or protocol treasury.
requirements: slash distribution policy is append-only and keyed to the exact frozen slash-policy commitment
recipient shares total exactly 10000 basis points
dynamic recipient classes require a code-hash-frozen resolver
protocol treasury routing is explicit and cannot be inferred
each slash authorization freezes exact distribution-policy revision and commitment before authorization succeeds
each slash authorization resolves and freezes the exact dynamic recipient addresses before authorization succeeds
distribution executor is reciprocally bound to the exact authorizer and distribution-policy contract
distribution is permissionless to relay but cannot alter frozen recipients/shares
worker and verifier slash execution is bounded by maxTranches and supports resumable multi-batch completion
partial tranche slashing cancels the original collateral obligation and rebinds the unslashed remainder to the immutable staker beneficiary
slashed value is paid through canonical Vault obligations, releases and claims rather than a parallel treasury
unprocessed/unreserved collateral remains canonically reserved for the staker
recipient-obligation operation identities are domain-separated by authorization, position and position revision
the slashed subject cannot receive its own slash distribution
authorization remains outstanding until the full authorized amount is distributed
final distribution consumes the authorization exactly once and clears only that authorization's outstanding amount
concrete verifier-dispute resolution can objectively resolve harmed payer and challenger
replacement-worker routing requires a resolver that can prove a canonical replacement worker; it is not invented by this step
payer escrow is not debited, mutated or treated as slash collateral
security_boundaries: CMP-1.5.6 cannot create slash authorization; it consumes only CMP-1.5.5 authorization
CMP-1.5.6 does not create reward accounting
CMP-1.5.6 does not mutate ComputeEscrow payer obligations
CMP-1.5.6 does not infer replacement workers
distribution policy changes after authorization cannot redirect an existing authorization
partial-batch interruption leaves outstanding authorization and blocks withdrawal until completion

milestone.rationale: slash distribution crosses authorization, worker/verifier collateral, recipient policy/resolution and canonical Vault cancel/create/release/claim accounting.
